sources.title: S. Mochizuki, Topics in Absolute Anabelian Geometry III: Global Reconstruction Algorithms
sources.version: November 2015 author version, as shown on the title page
sources.used_passages: Proposition 5.8(i)–(iii), pp.139–140: contravariant transfer reconstruction of the actual mono-analytic carrier and shell, and its log-volume normalization. Corollary 5.10(iv)(c),(d), pp.148–149: the natural Kummer/abelianization comparison through local reciprocity, and its shell compatibility. Used for the fixed-base-branch local membership proof, not as an abc theorem.

sources.title: S. Mochizuki, A version of the Grothendieck conjecture for p-adic local fields
sources.version: International Journal of Mathematics 8 (1997), 499–506; author PDF
sources.used_passages: Propositions 1.1–1.2 and Corollary 1.3, PDF pp.2–3: recovered inertia, cyclotomic character and absolute degree.

sources.title: J. S. Milne, Class Field Theory
sources.used_passages: Chapter III, Proposition 3.6 and Section 4; PDF pp.118–122: local pairing/reciprocity input to the separately proved trace covariance.

sources.title: J. H. Silverman, The Arithmetic of Elliptic Curves
sources.version: Second edition, Springer, 2009; previously archived private reading copy, not a deliverable
sources.used_passages: Chapters III, V and VII: isogeny quotients and duals, good-reduction Frobenius and integral-model minimality. These inputs remain outside the new Lean module.

sources.title: B. Mazur, with an appendix by D. Goldfeld, Rational isogenies of prime degree
sources.used_passages: Theorem 1, printed pp.129–130. The 1978 paper is not cited as already proving the completed composite cyclic-degree list.

sources.title: J. S. Balakrishnan and B. Mazur, with an appendix by N. Dogra, Ogg's torsion conjecture: Fifty years later
sources.used_passages: Theorem 2.2, printed p.239 / PDF p.5: complete unconditional rational cyclic-isogeny degree list, including CM. Read by the root and independent reviewer.

sources.title: S. Mochizuki, The étale theta function and its Frobenioid-theoretic manifestations
sources.version: Title page: December 2008; published in PRIMS 45 (2009). Filename year is not the PDF version date.
sources.used_passages: Proposition 1.4(ii)–(iii), PDF pp.20–21: original theta series, functional equation and Kummer evaluation.

sources.title: S. Mochizuki, Inter-universal Teichmüller Theory I
sources.used_passages: Example 3.2(ii),(iv), pp.70–71: reciprocal normalized theta root and its finite constant ambiguity. Corollary 5.3(ii), pp.143–145: the bijective lifting of D-prime-strip isomorphisms used with one synchronized copy identity; prior initial-data and theater constructions retained.

sources.title: S. Mochizuki, Inter-universal Teichmüller Theory II
sources.used_passages: Remark 1.12.2(i)–(ii), pp.58–59; Corollary 2.5 and Remark 2.5.1, pp.71–73: standard-type mu_(2ell) ambiguity, square labels and independence across labels.

sources.title: S. Mochizuki, Inter-universal Teichmüller Theory III
sources.used_passages: Definition 1.1, pp.23–25; Proposition 1.3, pp.41–43; Propositions 3.1,3.3–3.5, pp.93–106; 3.7–3.9, pp.109–117; Remark 3.9.5(vii), pp.131–134; Theorem 3.11 and Corollary 3.12, pp.153–184. Source links, words, local/global hulls, weighted determinants and the still distinct global comparison.

sources.title: S. Mochizuki, Inter-universal Teichmüller Theory IV
sources.used_passages: Proposition 1.4, p.13; Remark 1.7.1, p.17; Theorem 1.10 and proof, pp.22–30: exact local/word weights and the announced full-hull upper containers.

sources.title: K. Joshi, Construction of Arithmetic Teichmüller Spaces III
sources.version: arXiv:2401.13508v4, stamp February 24, 2025; title-page date February 25, 2025; preprint
sources.used_passages: Sections 9.7–9.11, pp.111–128: actual cohomology classes and collation, tensor-order normalization, convex/maximal-order distinction and the literal sign mismatch. No claimed global inequality is used as an axiom.

sources.title: K. Joshi, Construction of Arithmetic Teichmüller Spaces IV
sources.version: arXiv:2403.10430v2, stamp February 24, 2025; title-page date February 25, 2025; preprint
sources.used_passages: Theorem 6.10.1, Remark 6.10.2 and subsequent estimates, pp.66–71: the two collated families and the middle global equality, distinguished from our fixed-source covariance.
